空欄なら制限しません。両方にあるドメインは検索しません。両方を指定するとプロバイ: Empty means no limit. A domain on both lists is not searched. With both lists set, only the allowed domains are sent to the provider, so a blocked domain under an allowed one (such as sub.example.org under example.org) is still searched. OpenAI and ChatGPT cannot take a block list on its own, so with only a block list they do not search.
